messages:
clara.design: Morning team, posted a compact IA iteration that groups nav by workflow (Build / Serve / Observe). figma: https://figma.redwood/console/nav-compact-v4
evan.pm: nice direction. Main risk: customers with saved links. If we move 'Models' under Serve will legacy URLs keep working?
tom.frontend: plan: keep canonical paths stable and add an alias map for old segments. middleware will canonicalize incoming routes. During experiment we return 302 + banner, then cut over to 301 after grace period.
nina.a11y: a11y checklist: when groups collapse or reorder, move focus to the closest visible item and emit aria-live: "Navigation updated, focus moved to <label>". ensure group headers have aria-expanded and keyboard toggles.
clara.design: breadcrumbs should reflect resource hierarchy (/console/:org/:workspace/:section/:id). for quick actions we add compact action chips beside crumbs, not inside them.
evan.pm: prefer path segments + query params for UI state (avoid hashes for routing-critical state). example: /console/acme/prod/serve/mdl-42?panel=metrics&focus=logs
tom.frontend: dev notes: add data-legacy-path attrs to nav items for server + client mapping, log redirect hits (`legacy_segment`, `redirect_count`) for 45 days, show migration banner when redirect occurs.
nina.a11y: small copy nit: use U+203A for visual breadcrumb separator and aria-hidden it, provide aria-label on nav region. avoid exposing separators to screenreaders.
clara.design: rollout: internal canary -> 20% experiment -> full with 30d redirect telemetry review. banner copy draft: "You're viewing this page via a migration mapping. Update bookmark? [Copy link]"
evan.pm: also add a subtle toast on redirect: "Old link redirected to new location. Click to copy new URL."
tom.frontend: estimate ~3 dev days: alias table, middleware, banner+toast, aria-live/focus behavior, tests. I'll add a feature-flag gate.
deploy-bot: Created issue RED-8042: "Compact nav IA: alias redirects, breadcrumb contract & a11y checks" assigned to tom.frontend; due 2026-04-20.
